verdict.line: You lose long auto-trades into an available Counter Strike, but you win any fight where you land E first and dash in while his E is down.

brief.thesis: This matchup sits at 44.5% for Irelia over 1,036 games, well below her 50.2% average for the role, and OP.GG gives Jax both lane and solo-kill advantage. The reason is mechanical: Jax's E (Counter Strike, cooldown 18/16/14/12/10s) dodges every incoming basic attack and then stuns anything standing near him, which directly punishes Irelia's Ionian Fervor plan of weaving autos between spells. Fights only go your way when you force him to spend that cooldown before you commit.

theirWindow.what: Do not extend with basic attacks. He can bait an auto, dodge it, and stun you into a Q Leap Strike engage plus W (Empower) burst before you get your own CC off.

yourWindow.what: This is your engage window. Land E (Flawless Duet, CD 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s) to stun and Mark him, then Q (Bladesurge) dashes in with its cooldown refreshed off the Marked target for a free follow-up hit.

start.why: 87.1% pick rate at 46.5% win rate. The extra sustain matters because you need to survive to the point where Counter Strike is down before you can trade favorably.

boots.why: 83.5% pick rate at 45%. Jax's damage is entirely physical — his empowered autos and his no-cooldown R (Relentless Assault) attack-speed stacking — so flat armor blunts every one of his damage sources.

core.why: On-hit current-health damage rewards the auto-weaving that builds Ionian Fervor stacks, and the slow active helps you stick to Q Bladesurge dives.
Highest win rate core path listed (55.6% over 151 games with this line). Strong isolated damage for post-6 all-ins once you've landed E.
Bleed conversion and flat damage reduction let you survive the burst window when Jax lands Empower plus a Counter Strike stun.

situational.when: jax is stacking lifesteal or you need sustained magic resist through extended fights
you want a burstier second item over the sustained-fight Hullbreaker line
jax's R attack-speed stacking threatens to burst you down in a single extended trade

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror ramps through the extended trade and converts to healing, which matters because you need to outlast Jax's Empower burst rather than win a single short exchange.

summoners.why: Run in 72.4% of games at 46.2% win rate, the highest of the three options. Ignite closes out picks off a landed E-into-Q combo before Jax's Leap Strike lets him reset out of range.

playing.title: Hold E for the engage
playing.detail: Use E (Flawless Duet) as your primary engage while Counter Strike is down. It stuns and Marks him, which refreshes Q's cooldown for an immediate follow-up dash.

playing.title: Don't auto into an open E
playing.detail: If Counter Strike is up, feeding him basic attacks lets him dodge for free and turn the exchange into his stun. Wait it out.

playing.title: Charge W into his Empower
playing.detail: When Jax uses W (Empower) to threaten a big hit, hold W (Defiant Dance) — it takes reduced physical damage while charging and deals more damage the longer you hold it.

playing.title: Stack your passive before committing
playing.detail: Land spell hits to build Ionian Fervor stacks before you extend a trade. At max stacks the bonus on-hit damage is what turns an even fight in your favor.

playing.title: Dive when Leap Strike is down
playing.detail: Jax's Q (Leap Strike, CD 17/14/11/8/5s) is his only gap closer and escape. Once it's on cooldown he can't reposition, making it the safest window for a Q Bladesurge commitment.

playing.title: Disengage once his R is stacking
playing.detail: Relentless Assault has no cooldown and ramps attack speed with every hit, with every third strike dealing bonus damage. Don't stand in an auto-trade once it's active — burst him down or back off.

playing.title: Watch for Teleport resets
playing.detail: Flash+Teleport shows up in 9.6% of games. If Jax disappears after losing a trade, assume he can reset and re-enter lane — don't overextend on the wave.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the cooldown timings, ability interactions, and trade-window reading are my own analysis of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Try to engage whenever Jax’s Counter Strike (E) is on cooldown. Absorb Jax’s (W) damage with a well-timed [W], while waiting for an opportunity to strike back by keeping your [P] stacks up.
